fact: The Ministerial High-Level Committee on Economic Reform directed commercial banks collecting tax for the South Sudan Revenue Authority to comply with a policy requiring tax payments in cash, at its 14th regular meeting.
The South Sudan Revenue Authority said digital tax payments through Capital Pay will continue while SSP tax liabilities must otherwise be deposited at designated banks.
The National Revenue Authority chief said cash at immigration offices was abolished and passport and national ID fees are paid through a bank-linked digital system (Sudans Post).
system: bank-linked digital payment system for passports and national ID
